# Internet Archive
> Internet Archive is a nonprofit digital library offering free access to books, media, software, web archives, and preservation services.

The Internet Archive preserves and provides access to millions of texts, audio recordings, videos, software titles, images, and archived web pages through the Wayback Machine. Its sites include public collections, item and collection metadata, account and borrowing features, APIs, developer tools, and extensive help documentation for accessing, uploading, and preserving digital materials.

## Core Platforms
- [Internet Archive Home](https://archive.org/): Main portal for searching, accessing, uploading, and managing digital collections.
- [Wayback Machine](https://web.archive.org/): Web archive for browsing saved versions of websites across time.
- [Texts Collection](https://archive.org/details/texts): Books, journals, magazines, and other digitized text materials.
- [Audio Collection](https://archive.org/details/audio): Music, spoken word, radio, podcasts, and other audio recordings.
- [Moving Image Collection](https://archive.org/details/movies): Films, television, animation, and other video materials.
- [Software Collection](https://archive.org/details/software): Preserved software, games, and emulated computing environments.
- [Image Collection](https://archive.org/details/image): Photographs, artwork, maps, and other image-based materials.

## Search, Access, and Accounts
- [Search](https://archive.org/search): Search interface for items, collections, metadata, and media types.
- [Advanced Search](https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php): Structured search for fields, media types, collections, and output formats.
- [My Library](https://archive.org/account/library): Account area for loans, favorites, and saved items.
- [Favorites](https://archive.org/details/fav-): User-curated saved items and personal collections.
- [Borrowing Books](https://help.archive.org/help/borrowing-from-the-lending-library/): Help for borrowing controlled digital lending titles from the library.
- [Account Settings](https://archive.org/account/settings): Manage profile, preferences, and account-related options.

## Uploading and Item Management
- [Upload](https://archive.org/create/): Upload files and create new items with metadata and media settings.
- [Uploading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/uploading-a-basic-guide/): Introductory guide to creating and uploading items to archive.org.
- [Uploading a Basic Guide via the Browser](https://help.archive.org/help/uploading-a-basic-guide-via-the-browser/): Browser-based workflow for adding files and metadata.
- [How to Edit Metadata](https://help.archive.org/help/how-to-edit-metadata/): Instructions for updating item titles, descriptions, and other metadata fields.
- [How to Delete Files](https://help.archive.org/help/how-to-delete-files/): Guidance for removing files from an existing item.
- [How to Remove an Item](https://help.archive.org/help/how-to-remove-an-item/): Process for requesting deletion or removal of an item page.
- [Collections](https://archive.org/details/opensource): Example major collection showing how items are grouped and managed.

## Downloading and File Access
- [Downloading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide/): Overview of downloading files, formats, and access options.
- [About the Download Directory](https://help.archive.org/help/about-the-download-directory/): Explains item file listings and direct file access patterns.
- [Using Wget](https://help.archive.org/help/using-wget/): Command-line downloading guidance for retrieving files from archive.org.
- [How to Download Borrowed Books](https://help.archive.org/help/how-to-download-borrowed-books/): Instructions for offline access to eligible borrowed books.
- [File Formats and Derivatives](https://help.archive.org/help/file-formats/): Describes common source files and generated derivative formats.
- [PDF and ePub Downloads](https://help.archive.org/help/ebooks-and-texts/): Help for accessing ebook-friendly text formats.

## APIs and Developer Tools
- [Internet Archive APIs](https://archive.org/developers/): Developer portal for metadata, search, upload, and access interfaces.
- [Metadata API](https://archive.org/developers/metadata-api/index.html): Retrieve item metadata, file lists, reviews, and collection information.
- [Advanced Search API](https://archive.org/developers/advanced-search.html): Query archive.org search indexes programmatically with structured parameters.
- [Wayback Availability JSON API](https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php): Check whether archived snapshots exist for a given URL.
- [Wayback CDX Server API](https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php): Access capture indexes and timestamped snapshot records for archived URLs.
- [S3-like API](https://archive.org/developers/internetarchive/cli.html): Programmatic upload and management workflows used by archive tooling.
- [Internet Archive Python Library](https://archive.org/developers/internetarchive/): Official Python tooling for search, upload, and metadata operations.
- [Command-Line Interface](https://archive.org/developers/internetarchive/cli.html): CLI documentation for interacting with archive.org from scripts and terminals.

## Wayback Machine
- [Wayback Machine Home](https://web.archive.org/): Browse archived websites and submit URLs for capture.
- [Save Page Now](https://web.archive.org/save): On-demand archiving tool for saving a live web page.
- [Wayback Machine Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/the-wayback-machine/): Help center category covering browsing, saving, and troubleshooting archived pages.
- [Using the Wayback Machine](https://help.archive.org/help/using-the-wayback-machine/): Introductory guide to searching and navigating web captures.
- [Save Pages in the Wayback Machine](https://help.archive.org/help/save-pages-in-the-wayback-machine/): Instructions for preserving specific URLs with Save Page Now.
- [Wayback Machine APIs](https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php): Technical reference for availability and capture index endpoints.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://help.archive.org/help/): Main support portal for archive.org services and workflows.
- [Account and Login Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/accounts/): Support articles for registration, login, and account management.
- [Books and Texts Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/books-and-texts/): Help for reading, borrowing, and downloading text materials.
- [Audio and Music Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/audio-and-music/): Support for audio playback, metadata, and collection use.
- [Video Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/moving-images/): Articles covering moving image access, formats, and uploads.
- [Uploading and Managing Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/uploading-and-managing/): Documentation for creating, editing, and maintaining items.
- [Wayback Machine Help Category](https://help.archive.org/help/category/the-wayback-machine/): Support resources for web archiving and replay features.

## Collections and Special Libraries
- [Open Library](https://openlibrary.org/): Separate Internet Archive project for editable book records and lending access.
- [TV News Archive](https://archive.org/details/tv): Searchable archive of television news broadcasts and transcripts.
- [Live Music Archive](https://archive.org/details/etree): Community collection of live concert recordings and performances.
- [Community Video](https://archive.org/details/opensource_movies): User-contributed films, documentaries, and video uploads.
- [Community Audio](https://archive.org/details/opensource_audio): User-contributed music, podcasts, and spoken recordings.
- [Community Texts](https://archive.org/details/opensource): User-contributed books, zines, and textual materials.
- [Web Collection](https://archive.org/details/web): Archived web data and web-related collections.

## Blogs, Projects, and About
- [Internet Archive Blogs](https://blog.archive.org/): News, announcements, preservation projects, and organizational updates.
- [About the Internet Archive](https://archive.org/about/): Overview of the organization, mission, and major services.
- [Projects](https://archive.org/projects/): Highlights of preservation, digitization, and access initiatives.
- [Donate](https://archive.org/donate): Support the nonprofit’s preservation and access work.
- [Jobs](https://archive.org/about/jobs.php): Employment opportunities across engineering, libraries, and operations.
- [Terms of Use](https://archive.org/about/terms.php): Legal terms governing use of archive.org services and content.
- [Privacy Policy](https://archive.org/about/terms.php#privacy-policy): Privacy practices and data handling policies for users.
